During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''battle''' over the [[Mining/Legends|mines]] took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Begeren]].

==The battle==
The battle of [[Begeren]] took place sometime between the [[Battle of Toprawa]] and the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="GG12" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

The battle was fought over the Begeren's [[Mining/Legends|mines]].<ref name="FaD">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> It resulted in a victory for the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="GG12" /><ref name="TEA" />

==Aftermath==
News of the Rebel Alliance victory spread as far as [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], giving hope to the native [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]] that they, too, might achieve freedom from their [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] oppressors.<ref name="GG12" />
